gap: No result ChatGPT got prices a full camera-plus-remote-gate-release setup below JAGER PRO's $1,800 kit. AnywhereCam's Eagle 4G Wireless Trapper Edition is $557 with the camera, a transmitter and a receiver, and its data plan is listed at $18.67/month. JAGER PRO's own page lists $40/month, not the $55 ChatGPT quoted.
standout_why: I compared against the three cited pages and the uncited JAGER PRO results. JAGER PRO's Live Stream page gives $599 for the camera and $40/month for data, but no price for the gate it needs. The $1,800 complete kit is only on the DIY Conversion Kit page (rank 6, not cited). The hogtraptrigger.com home page shows no prices; its shop page has $799 and $999 trigger units with no camera. The hogeyecameras.com home, buy-now and steel-camera pages show no price at all. None of the results mentions AnywhereCam, so a camera with a remote trigger for under $600 does not appear anywhere ChatGPT looked.
decides: For a shopper who already has a trap, the cheapest sourced all-in setup is the AnywhereCam Eagle 4G Wireless Trapper Edition. It costs $557 plus $18.67/month, about $781 for the first year. JAGER PRO's camera and control-box kit costs $1,800 plus $40/month, or $2,280 for the first year. Hog Trap Trigger is $799–$999 before you buy any camera. JAGER PRO still wins if the shopper wants an electronic latch and an onsite remote in the box (300+ yard range): its kit lists both, and the AnywhereCam page lists only a 9 V relay with the battery not included. We never fetched AnywhereCam's latch details.
